exceptions.scope: Patched Docusaurus update-notifier public npm version lookup only; not a Rivet runtime or shared authenticated-response cache.
exceptions.reason: No confirmed upstream fix for GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp. The checked-in Yarn patch makes evaluateRequest synchronously revalidate every zero-lifetime entry, preventing max-stale and stale-while-revalidate from reviving security-zeroed responses. Regression tests through the actual cacheable-request consumer cover shared Set-Cookie, private, no-store, no-cache and proxy-revalidate entries, serialized policies, and ordinary public caching. Yarn still audits the underlying 4.2.0 version. This entry acknowledges the verified local mitigation, not the original vulnerable code; remove it and the patch when an upstream fix passes the same tests.
